title: Côte d'Ivoire cocoa cooperative, irregular rainfall, names a person and a phone number (English)
profile_note: Synthetic producer (#7): cocoa cooperative, Bas-Sassandra, Côte d'Ivoire (the same producer as S7). The PII path: the producer names a person and gives a phone number (both invented). The record is flagged, never redacted.

turns.message: The rain has become irregular and this year's cocoa harvest dropped a lot.
It got worse over the last two seasons. The technician Kouame Konan came to help us check the trees, and you can reach him at +225 07 00 00 00 00. We water by hand when we can, but it is not enough.

intake_replies: We also dug small channels to catch what little rain does fall.
